helpPage.title: Guide & Instructions
helpPage.subtitle: How to send your downloaded stickers to WhatsApp and other messaging apps
helpPage.whatsappStep1: Download the sticker (GIF if animated, WebP if static).
helpPage.whatsappStep2: Open WhatsApp on your phone or Web and enter any chat.
helpPage.whatsappStep3: Open the stickers panel and tap 'Create' (+).
helpPage.whatsappStep4: Select the downloaded file from your device and save it.
helpPage.otherAppsStep1: Download your favorite stickers from Stickerity.
helpPage.otherAppsStep2: Open a third-party app like Sticker Maker or Sticker.ly.
helpPage.otherAppsStep3: Create a sticker pack and add the downloaded files.
helpPage.otherAppsStep4: Tap 'Add to WhatsApp' to export them all to your keyboard.

homeSeo.step1Desc: Copy any public URL with images, GIFs, or stickers.
homeSeo.step2Desc: Stickerity analyzes and processes stickers automatically.
homeSeo.step3Desc: Download individually or in batch as a ZIP package in WebP/GIF.
homeSeo.faq1Q: What sticker formats can I download?
homeSeo.faq1A: You can download stickers in WebP (static) or GIF (animated), as well as complete ZIP packages.
homeSeo.faq2Q: Is it free and without registration?
homeSeo.faq2A: Yes, Stickerity is 100% free and requires no account creation or extra apps.
homeSeo.faq3Q: How do I add stickers to WhatsApp?
homeSeo.faq3A: Simply download them and use the 'Create' option in WhatsApp's stickers section.

terms.section1Text: Stickerity is an online utility tool designed to process and adapt images from public links into formats compatible with messaging applications (such as WhatsApp).
terms.section2Text: Stickerity does not store, host, sell, or claim intellectual property rights over any processed images. The user is solely responsible for acquiring and using content extracted through public links.
terms.section3Text: WhatsApp and other mentioned trademarks belong to their respective owners and are not affiliated with this platform.

privacy.section1Text: Stickerity does not require registration or store personal user data.
privacy.section2Text: Links entered by the user are temporarily processed in memory to convert image formats and are discarded immediately afterward.
privacy.section3Text: We use basic local storage solely for technical caching and application performance.

aboutPage.title: About Stickerity
aboutPage.subtitle: The easiest way to convert web images into WhatsApp stickers.
aboutPage.whatIsText: Stickerity is a free web tool that extracts stickers and images from any public link and converts them to formats compatible with WhatsApp (WebP, GIF). It was designed to simplify the process of bringing the content you love on the internet directly into your chats.
aboutPage.whyText: Normally, downloading a web sticker involves using multiple apps, searching for compatible formats, or dealing with files that WhatsApp won't recognize. Stickerity automates this process: you paste the link, we analyze the content, process the images on our servers temporarily, and deliver a WebP or GIF file ready to be imported using WhatsApp's native 'Create Sticker' feature.
aboutPage.privacyText: We believe in clean, safe tools. Stickerity requires no registration, does not keep a history of what you download, does not track your identity, and does not store processed images on the server long-term.
